summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, its routine foreign-private-issuer current report, attaching a press release titled 'IceCure Highlights Clinical Data and Strong Physician Engagement for ProSense Breast Cancer Cryoablation at EUSOBI 2026.' The release describes scientific presentations, posters and two physician workshops at the European Society of Breast Imaging annual meeting in Maastricht, citing 12-month objective response rates of 97.5% across 40 patients treated with cryoablation plus endocrine therapy and 91.7% across 24 patients treated with cryoablation alone. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory mechanics are disclosed; it is an ordinary product and clinical-data update, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle arise.
